title: Greek Yogurt Protein Bowl
method: Add Greek yogurt to a bowl.
Top with oats, banana, blueberries and chia seeds.
Drizzle honey and almond butter on top.
Enjoy!
notes: Use any berries you have.
Add a scoop of protein powder for extra protein.
Great for busy mornings!

title: Cottage Cheese & Berries
method: Add cottage cheese to a bowl.
Top with berries, honey and almonds.
Enjoy!
notes: High protein and refreshing.
Swap berries for banana or apple.
Add cinnamon if you like!

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken & Rice
method: Cook rice according to package directions.
Season chicken with salt, pepper and herbs. Cook in olive oil until golden and cooked through.
Sauté garlic, add broccoli and cook until tender.
Add lemon juice, toss everything together and serve.
notes: Meal prep friendly.
Store in the fridge up to 3 days.
Swap chicken for salmon or tofu.

title: Berry Cheesecake Cup
method: Spoon the skyr into a small glass or bowl.
Add berries and crushed biscuits.
Drizzle with honey and serve.
notes: A sweet treat that still has some protein.
Use any berries you like.

title: Overnight Oats with Peanut Butter
method: Combine oats, milk, chia seeds and cinnamon in a jar.
Stir in the peanut butter.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Top with sliced banana before eating.
notes: Prep 3-4 jars at once for the week.
Swap peanut butter for any nut butter.
Add a scoop of protein powder if you like.

title: Hummus & Veggie Sticks
method: Spoon hummus into a small bowl.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Arrange the veggie sticks around the bowl for dipping.
Enjoy!
notes: Great for prepping ahead in containers.
Swap in any crunchy veg you have on hand.

title: Turkey Chili
method: Brown the turkey in a large pot, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add onion and garlic, cook until soft.
Stir in tomatoes, beans, chili powder and cumin.
Simmer 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season to taste and serve.
notes: Freezes well in individual portions.
Great over rice or with cornbread.
Swap turkey for lean beef or lentils.

title: Dark Chocolate Protein Mug Cake
method: Whisk all ingredients together in a mug until smooth.
Microwave on high for 60-90 seconds.
Let cool slightly before eating.
Top with a few extra chocolate chips if you like.
notes: Watch closely near the end so it doesn't overflow.
Great for a quick sweet fix with protein.

title: Chicken Wraps
method: Season and pan-fry the chicken breast fillet until cooked through, then slice.
Pan-fry or steam the frozen vegetables until tender.
Warm the protein wrap.
Fill with chicken, vegetables and light sauce, then roll up.
Serve with the FIZI on the side.
notes: Macros are per-ingredient estimates from the original source, not a lab analysis.

title: Chicken Fajita Quesadilla
method: Season and cook the chicken, then slice.
Sauté the pepper-onion mix until softened.
Lay the wrap flat, and cover one half with chicken, vegetables and shredded cheddar.
Fold and toast in a dry pan until golden and the cheese melts.
Slice and serve.

title: Chicken Pizza Wrap
method: Cook the chicken and slice or shred it.
Spread the passata over the wrap.
Top with chicken, mozzarella, bell pepper and sweetcorn.
Fold or roll, then warm in a pan or oven until the cheese melts.
Serve.

title: Chicken Parmesan Pasta
method: Cook the protein pasta according to the package directions.
Season and pan-fry the chicken until cooked through, then slice.
Warm the passata in a pan.
Toss the pasta with the passata and chicken.
Top with parmesan and serve.

title: Loaded Chicken Fries Bowl
method: Season and cook the chicken, then slice.
Bake the frozen oven fries according to the package directions.
Sauté the bell pepper until tender.
Build the bowl: fries on the bottom, then chicken, bell pepper and cheddar.
Drizzle with light sauce and serve.

title: Loaded Sweet Potato Chicken Bowl
ingredients: 200 g sweet potato fries (air fryer or oven)
method: Season and cook the chicken, then slice.
Air-fry or oven-bake the sweet potato fries until crisp.
Sauté the bell pepper until tender.
Build the bowl: sweet potato fries on the bottom, then chicken, bell pepper and cheddar.
Drizzle with light sauce and serve.

title: Chicken Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1/2 More Protein Wrap, torn into croutons
method: Season and cook the chicken, then slice.
Toast the torn wrap pieces in a dry pan until crisp, to make croutons.
Toss the romaine, cucumber and tomatoes in a large bowl.
Top with chicken, croutons and parmesan.
Drizzle with the Caesar cheese sauce and serve.

title: Chicken Cheddar Melt
method: Season and cook the chicken, then slice.
Toast the bread.
Layer chicken, cheddar, lettuce, sweetcorn and pickles between the toast.
Spread with the burger sauce.
Serve warm.

title: Chicken Mac & Cheese
method: Cook the pasta according to the package directions.
Season and pan-fry the chicken, then slice.
In a saucepan, warm the milk with the light cheddar, parmesan and cream cheese, stirring until melted and smooth.
Toss the pasta and chicken through the cheese sauce.
Season with spices and serve.

title: Chicken Alfredo Pasta
method: Cook the pasta according to the package directions.
Season and pan-fry the chicken, then slice.
Warm the light cooking cream in a pan and stir in the parmesan until smooth.
Toss the pasta and chicken through the sauce.
Serve.

title: Chicken Veggie Tomato Pasta
method: Cook the pasta according to the package directions.
Season and pan-fry the chicken, then slice.
Sauté the frozen vegetables, then stir in the passata and light cooking cream.
Toss the pasta and chicken through the sauce.
Top with parmesan and serve.

title: Chicken Tomato Tortellini
method: Cook the tortellini according to the package directions.
Season and pan-fry the chicken, then slice.
Sauté the frozen vegetables, then stir in the passata and light cooking cream.
Toss the tortellini and chicken through the sauce.
Top with parmesan and serve.
notes: ⚠️ Carbs, fat and fiber weren't in the original notes — needs real numbers.

title: Chicken Vegetable Gratin
method: Season and pan-fry the chicken, then slice.
Steam the broccoli, carrots and cauliflower until just tender.
Layer the chicken and vegetables in an ovenproof dish.
Pour over the light cooking cream and top with the light cheese.
Bake until golden and bubbling, then serve.

title: Chicken Parmesan
method: Bread and cook the chicken until golden and cooked through.
Warm the passata in a small pan.
Top the chicken with passata, mozzarella and parmesan.
Grill or bake until the cheese melts.
Serve with steamed broccoli.
notes: ⚠️ Carbs, fat and fiber weren't in the original notes — needs real numbers.

title: Chicken Potato Gratin
method: Season and pan-fry the chicken, then slice.
Thinly slice the potatoes and layer in an ovenproof dish.
Pour over the light cooking cream, and season with garlic, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Top with parmesan and light cheese.
Bake until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden, then serve with the chicken.
notes: ⚠️ Fiber wasn't in the original notes — needs a real number.

title: Chicken Broccoli Gratin
method: Season and pan-fry the chicken, then slice.
Steam the broccoli until just tender.
Layer the chicken and broccoli in an ovenproof dish.
Pour over the light cooking cream, season with garlic, pepper and paprika, and top with parmesan and light cheese.
Bake until golden and serve.
notes: ⚠️ Fiber wasn't in the original notes — needs a real number.

title: Cheeseburger Chicken Wrap
method: Season and cook the chicken, then slice.
Warm the wrap.
Fill with chicken, cheddar, burger sauce, pickles, onions and lettuce.
Roll up and serve.

title: Chicken Philly Cheesesteak Wrap
method: Season and cook the chicken, then slice.
Sauté the bell pepper and onions until softened.
Warm the wrap and fill with chicken, peppers, onions and light cheese.
Add a spoon of light mayo.
Roll up and serve.

title: Philly Cheesesteak Chicken Sandwich
method: Season and cook the chicken, then slice.
Sauté the bell pepper and onions until softened.
Toast the bread.

title: Chicken Club Guacamole Wrap
method: Season and cook the chicken, then slice.
Warm the wrap.
Spread with guacamole, then add chicken, cheddar, tomatoes and lettuce.

title: Chicken Guacamole Fries Bowl

title: Chicken Quesadilla with Guacamole & Tomatoes

Top with guacamole and diced tomatoes.
Slice and serve.

title: Lentil Soup with Chicken & Pretzel Roll
method: Season and pan-fry the chicken, then slice.

title: Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta
method: Cook the pasta according to the package directions.

Warm the light cooking cream in a pan and stir in the pesto and parmesan.

Stir in the light cooking cream and cream cheese until smooth, then add the parmesan.
Toss the pasta and chicken through the sauce, season with parsley, and serve.

title: Chicken Pesto Melt

title: Brownie Baked Oats
